::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 13th [1868]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171: Box 29
:::

My dear [Miss Sewell](people/person_1301.qmd),
I was so hurried that I could not go to [Macmillan](people/person_939.qmd) yesterday so I am writing.

I have done the notes[^1] - the Joyeuse Garde beats both [Mary Coleridge](people/person_351.qmd) and me, we both thought it a real castle on the Seine - and never heard of its being an Order.

Michaud’s [Histoire de Croisades](other_books/otherbook_116.qmd) has almost exactly the same about Simeon & his persecutions as [Milman](other_books/otherbook_411.qmd), and I dont know where to find more - in fact I think Milman copied him

Roman must be Norman

Yours sincerely
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: These were the notes to the anthology of historical writing *Historical Selections* which they had jointly compiled.
